verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Bitbucket integration for viewing development status, automation that keeps Jira up to date from other tools, a Trello sync, and a REST API. None of it documents a first-party bi-directional sync between Jira tasks and a code repository's issue tracker. Viewing dev status and one-way automation are adjacent features. Trello is not a code repository issue tracker. Marketplace apps and the REST API are third-party or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
